Ability to build rapport with adolescents and to maintain strict confidentiality. Punctual and reliable, willing to work variable shifts and travel extensively. salary_details.details: The appointment is on a contractual basis for the Project period (MPOWER Project). The notice mentions no allowances.

selection_process: Screening: all applications are subjected to a screening process constituted for the purpose. Written test/personal interview: shortlisted candidates have to undergo this stage.
Updates on the written test/interview will appear on the NHM Meghalaya website (nhmmeghalaya.nic.in); the notice says no other form of communication will be sent from the concerned office.
how_to_apply: Open the Google form link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/G2fzSnJsHXccL61d9
Register in the Google form using a Gmail account only.
Prepare your CV and supporting scanned documents as a single PDF file.
Rename the PDF with your first and last name; its total size must be less than 15 MB.
When uploading, select the PDF file from your local device/drive.
Submit the form on or before 5:00 PM on 30 November 2026.
CV with supporting scanned documents, in a single PDF file.
All relevant certificates, testimonials etc. in original, to be produced at the time of the interview if shortlisted.
"No Objection Certificate" from the employer, for those in employment, at the time of the interview.
important_instructions: Filling in the Google form is mandatory for applying. Only a Gmail account may be used for registration. Each candidate should apply only once. Candidates in employment must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of the interview. Original certificates and testimonials must be produced at the interview if shortlisted. The Mission Director reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About NHM Meghalaya
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Mission Director, National Health Mission, Meghalaya, Shillong. The posts are for the MPOWER Project, which aims at strengthening the existing RKSK (Adolescent Health Program) implemented across health facilities in Meghalaya.

content_sections.heading: NHM Meghalaya Adolescent Health Counsellor Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications are open as of 24 November 2026. The dates of the written test/interview are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: NHM Meghalaya Adolescent Health Counsellor Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice lists 55 posts of Adolescent Health Counsellor, marked "across Blocks".

content_sections.heading: NHM Meghalaya Adolescent Health Counsellor Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The notice lists these further requirements for the post: At least 1 year of experience as a counsellor or teacher dealing with adolescents and allied field. Knowledge of adolescent reproductive health, family planning, life skills and youth development. Computer skills, including basic MS office and use of apps for reporting. Ability to build rapport with adolescents and to maintain strict confidentiality. Punctual and reliable, willing to work variable shifts and travel extensively. Preference for local candidates and those who can communicate the local language. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification_required: Clinical Psychologist, or MSc/MA in Psychology, Masters in Social Work with specialization in counselling from a recognized institution.

content_sections.heading: NHM Meghalaya Adolescent Health Counsellor Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a contractual basis for the Project period (MPOWER Project). The notice mentions no allowances.

content_sections.heading: NHM Meghalaya Adolescent Health Counsellor Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The notice describes two stages, in this order: Screening: all applications are subjected to a screening process constituted for the purpose. Written test/personal interview: shortlisted candidates have to undergo this stage. Updates on the written test/interview will appear on the NHM Meghalaya website (nhmmeghalaya.nic.in); the notice says no other form of communication will be sent from the concerned office.

faq.question: Q1. How many Adolescent Health Counsellor posts is NHM Meghalaya recruiting for?
faq.answer: NHM Meghalaya has announced 55 posts of Adolescent Health Counsellor across Blocks, to be posted at CHC/PHC.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NHM Meghalaya Adolescent Health Counsellor?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026, and the Google form must be submitted on or before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Adolescent Health Counsellor at NHM Meghalaya?
faq.answer: Clinical Psychologist, or MSc/MA in Psychology, Masters in Social Work with specialization in counselling from a recognized institution, plus at least 1 year of experience as a counsellor or teacher dealing with adolescents and allied field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of an NHM Meghalaya Adolescent Health Counsellor?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration is ₹26,000-/ per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for NHM Meghalaya Adolescent Health Counsellor recruitment?
faq.answer: Fill the Google form at https://forms.gle/G2fzSnJsHXccL61d9 using a Gmail account and upload the CV with supporting scanned documents in a single PDF of less than 15 MB, renamed with your first and last name.

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected for NHM Meghalaya Adolescent Health Counsellor?
faq.answer: All applications go through a screening process, and shortlisted candidates have to undergo a written test/personal interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NHM Meghalaya Adolescent Health Counsellor job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the notice invites applications to fill the positions on a contractual basis for the Project period (MPOWER Project).

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply more than once on the Google form?
faq.answer: No, the notice says candidates should apply only once using the Google form.

faq.question: Q9. Do employed candidates need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes, those in employment must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where will updates on the written test or interview appear?
faq.answer: Updates will appear on the NHM Meghalaya website, nhmmeghalaya.nic.in; no other form of communication will be sent from the concerned office.
